svg.title: Instance B crashes, and instance A takes over its partitions from the last checkpoint
svg.desc: The checkpoint store, blob container ops-console, holds an ownership and checkpoint record for each partition of the event hub van-positions, which the telemetry-ingest processor reads through the consumer group ops-console. Instance A owns partitions 0 and 1, instance B owns partitions 2 and 3, and both renew their records regularly and write a checkpoint after every event. B pushes event 8 of partition 2 and crashes before it writes that checkpoint, so the checkpoint stays at event 7. Its records keep the last-modified time 10:42:20 and turn grey. At 10:42:50 instance A claims partitions 2 and 3 and reads them from their checkpoints, event 7 in partition 2 and event 6 in partition 3, so event 8 of partition 2 is processed a second time, which is why the handler must be idempotent. In partition 3 the checkpoint was at event 6 when B crashed, so no event there is processed twice.
svg.text: A owns partitions 0 and 1, B owns 2 and 3, and both write a checkpoint after every event
B pushes event 8 of partition 2 and crashes before its checkpoint, so its records stop changing
A sees the old last-modified time and takes over partitions 2 and 3 from the last checkpoint
Event 8 in partition 2 is processed twice, so the handler must be idempotent
event hub van-positions, consumer group ops-console
